describe.Counter: Counters go up, and reset when the process restarts.
describe.Gauge: Gauges are similar to Counters but a Gauge's value can be decreased.
describe.Histogram: Histograms track sizes and frequency of events.
describe.Summary: Summaries calculate percentiles of observed values.
describe.metrics: You can remove all metrics by calling `register.clear()`. You can also remove a single metric by calling `register.removeSingleMetric(*name of metric*)`.
